name: API Isarud Trade Compliance
author: Seçkin Sefa Durası

sections.description:
Isarud screens every WooCommerce order against 32,000+ sanctions entries from 8 international lists. Also works standalone without WooCommerce for manual screening via the Isarud API.

Features

  • Auto-screen billing/shipping names on every order
  • Optional checkout blocking for sanctioned entities
  • Order meta box showing compliance status
  • Email alerts on sanctions match
  • Works with WooCommerce HPOS
  • Standalone API access (without WooCommerce)

Lists Covered

OFAC SDN, OFAC Consolidated, EU, UN, UK HMT, Canada SEMA, World Bank
sections.installation:
1. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate
  3. Go to Isarud menu, enter API key from isarud.com
  4. Done – orders are auto-screened
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Complete rewrite with Isarud API v1
  • Sanctions screening (was marketplace API)
  • HPOS support, email alerts, checkout blocking

1.0.0

  • Initial release (marketplace API)
